What is the origin of the English word 'salary'?
'Salary' comes from the Latin word 'salarium,' which was a payment to Roman soldiers for salt. This historical link underscores the importance of salt in ancient economies and trade.

What describes the Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle in quantum mechanics?

The Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle states that it is impossible to measure both the position and momentum of a particle with arbitrary precision. The more precisely one quantity is known, the less precisely the other is known. This is a central concept in quantum mechanics.
